report_identity.report_title: Value Partners Group Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: Value Partners Group Limited is an asset manager providing investment management, advisory and securities dealing services, with revenue mainly from management fees and performance fees.
segments: Securities dealing and related regulated activities
Seed capital and investment holdings in funds, listed securities, joint ventures and investment property
business_overview.revenue_model: Fee income from assets under management, including management fees and performance fees, net of distribution fee expenses.
business_notes: 2025 fee income was HK$922.130 million, including gross management fees of HK$410.9 million and gross performance fees of HK$374.3 million.
The group is regulated in Hong Kong, Singapore and mainland China for asset management, advisory and dealing activities; regulated entities are subject to capital or licensing requirements.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 profit was not matched by operating cash flow because fee receivables increased by HK$375.545 million; three-year results show volatile profit and weak recurring cash conversion.

evidence.source: 2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, page 67; HK$'000

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by listed parent, operating subsidiaries and regulated capital at a granular level.
The report discloses money market instruments as cash equivalents and FVTPL because of significant influence, but does not provide fund-by-fund redemption gates or related lock-up terms.
Maintenance capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets is used as a conservative proxy.
